screens.name: perf-before
steps: Open C:\MGLab\power-bi\ep08\src\ContosoPerf.Before.pbip; Transform data > Edit parameters > DataFolder = C:\ContosoBikesPerf; Refresh and note the duration
Page Executive: Optimize ribbon > Performance Analyzer > Start recording > Refresh visuals (twice; record the second, warm run)
Expand the visuals: show the DAX query and visual display categories; keep the slowest visual and its duration in view
Type the durations into results\performance-analyzer.csv (before_ms) for the later comparison
mask: account name and picture at the top right of Power BI Desktop (sign out first)
Windows user name in any file path (record from C:\MGLab)

screens.name: perf-sizes
steps: Same file, DAX query view: paste queries\01-column-sizes.dax and Run
Sort the grid by DICTIONARY_SIZE descending: Sales columns LineRef, OrderTimestamp, Note, OrderNumber on top (record the real order and sizes)
mask: account name and picture at the top right of Power BI Desktop (sign out first)
Windows user name in any file path (record from C:\MGLab)

screens.name: perf-after
steps: Executive page: Performance Analyzer, same year selection, Start recording, Refresh visuals (second run); type after_ms into the csv (leave tableLines empty)
DAX query view: 01-column-sizes.dax again: the big dictionaries gone (no LineRef, Note, OrderTimestamp)
mask: account name and picture at the top right of Power BI Desktop (sign out first)
Windows user name in any file path (record from C:\MGLab)

screens.name: perf-compare
screens.note: results\performance-analyzer.csv holds the numbers typed from the two Performance Analyzer recordings (done by hand during pabefore and afterscreen). Then show both reports' cards side by side in Desktop (identical: Sales amount 2,846,324,198.90, Margin 40.0%).
